background.quote: Mr. Essa Al Saleh is a global CEO and Board Director with over 28 years of experience building, scaling and exiting businesses across the Middle East, Europe, Asia and the Americas.
His career spans public, private and venture-backed companies, with a consistent record of leading large-scale transformation, acquisition-led growth and capital strategy.

As CEO of Agility Global Integrated Logistics (GIL), he led the business from a single-country operation with approximately US$300 million in revenue into a global logistics enterprise with approximately US$4 billion in revenue, operations across more than 100 countries, and over 18,000 employees.
He drove this growth through more than 40 acquisitions across four continents, integrated them into one global network, and subsequently developed the business until it was sold for US$4.8 billion.
Mr. Ravi Jakhar is the Group Chief Financial Officer and Director – Strategy.

He leads the overall strategy and finance functions for Allcargo group, besides overseeing the Allcargo Global business in North America, Latin America, Oceania and strategic joint ventures across the globe.
He also oversees the global operations, internal audit, and legal function, with respective heads reporting to him.
With over two decades of experience in leadership/CXO positions, Ravi brings a unique blend of general management, entrepreneurship, business strategy, and consulting experience.
